## Checklist

- [ ] Linked issue (`Closes #N`) or a short reason this has none
- [ ] Title follows Conventional Commits (`feat:`, `fix:`, `docs:`, `chore:`, …)
- [ ] `bun run typecheck`, `bun run test`, and `bun run build` are green
- [ ] ADR added or updated if an architectural boundary or product term changed
- [ ] `CONTEXT.md` updated in this PR if vocabulary changed
- [ ] New or changed `shared/ui/` components are registered on `/design` in this PR
- [ ] Branch is `feat/` / `fix/` / `chore/`; this is not a push to `main`

See [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) for the full checklist. [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md) is the canonical rule set.
